name: Vadilal Industries Ltd
tagline: 115-year-old Indian ice cream/frozen dessert brand with low debt and a genuine category tailwind (rising organized ice cream consumption), but thin single-digit-to-low-teens margins and no confirmed hypergrowth math - a solid small-cap compounder candidate, not a 10x/100x case.

fundamentals_narrative: Vadilal is riding a real, structural tailwind - organized ice cream/frozen dessert consumption growing off a low per-capita base in India, with the brand well established via 27 industry awards over 4 years and 'most trusted brand in ice cream' recognition. Balance sheet is clean (D/E ~0.12) and the stock has re-rated ~38% over the past year, but ROCE/ROE figures were not clearly confirmed this pass, and the ~34x P/E on a ~13% net margin, decades-old business does not show the explosive earnings-growth math that would support a genuine 10x/100x label - this reads as a category-tailwind compounder rather than a hypergrowth story.
